hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.controller.ts ]] && grep -qE '@Api(Operation|Body|Response|Param|Query|Header|Produces)\(' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: Swagger decorators belong in docs/*.docs.ts files, not inline on controllers. Use applyDecorators() in the docs/ folder.' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts && "$FILE" != *.docs.ts && "$FILE" != *.dto.ts ]] && grep -nE '^\s*/\*\*' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '@deprecated' | head -1 | grep -q '.'; then echo '⚠️  WARNING: Use // comments, not /** */ JSDoc style. Only /** @deprecated */ is allowed.' >&2; fi; exit 0

FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *src/modules/* || "$FILE" == *src/services/* ]] && grep -qE "import.*\b(BadRequestException|UnauthorizedException|NotFoundException|ConflictException|ForbiddenException)\b.*from '@nestjs/common'" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: Import exceptions from @vritti/api-sdk, NOT @nestjs/common' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.controller.ts ]] && grep -nE '^[^/]*return\s+await\s+' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -3 | grep -q '.'; then echo '⚠️  WARNING: Avoid "return await" in controllers unless inside try-catch. Just return the Promise directly for better performance.' >&2; fi; exit 0

FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *src/db/schema/* && "$FILE" != *workspace-scope.ts ]] && grep -nE "['\"][a-z_]+\.[a-z_]+['\"]" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "owner:|table:|from |join " | head -3 | grep -q '.'; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: Schema-qualified table names must not be hardcoded in a schema file. Pass the drizzle table object instead (owner: offerings, not '"'"'commerce.offerings'"'"'). See db-schema.md.' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *src/db/schema/* && "$FILE" != *workspace-scope.ts ]] && grep -q "pgPolicy('org_isolation'" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo '⚠️  WARNING: Use orgIsolationPolicy() from workspace-scope.ts instead of inlining pgPolicy("org_isolation", ...). See db-schema.md.' >&2; fi; exit 0

FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *src/db/migrations/*.sql ]]; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: Never hand-write or edit a migration.sql. Use pnpm db:generate (structure) or pnpm db:generate:custom (data). See db-schema.md.' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.tsx ]] && perl -0777 -ne 'while(/disabled=\{([^{}]+)\}\s*(?:\n\s*)?disabledTip=\{\s*([^?{}]+?)\s*\?/g){my($d,$g)=($1,$2);$d=~s/^\s+|\s+$//g;$g=~s/^\s+|\s+$//g;my $n=$d;$n=~s/^!//;print 1 if $g eq $d or $g eq $n or q{!}.$g eq $d;}' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 1; then echo '⚠️  WARNING: disabledTip repeats the disabled condition. Button/Switch only render the tip when the control is actually disabled, so the ternary is dead code — pass the string directly. Keep the ternary only when the guard differs from disabled. See frontend-conventions.md.' >&2; fi; exit 0
